query: MARKET_RESEARCH/structured_notice_type: select notice_id, solicitation_number, title, notice_type, active where active and (notice_type.imatch."(sources sought|\\mrfi\\M|request for information)") order by notice_id limit 4

MARKET_RESEARCH/title_keyword: select notice_id, solicitation_number, title, notice_type, active where active and (and(notice_type.imatch."(special notice|presol|pre-sol)",or(title.imatch."\\m(rfis?|requests? for information|sources sought|market research|market survey)\\M"))) order by notice_id limit 4

VEHICLE_SOLICITATIONS/title_keyword: select notice_id, solicitation_number, title, notice_type, active where active and (and(notice_type.imatch."(solicitation|combined|consolidat|bundle)",or(title.imatch."\\m(idiqs?|id/iq|indefinite[-\\s]+delivery|maccs?|matocs?|satocs?|jocs?|job order contract(s|ing)?|bpas?|blanket purchase agreements?|multiple[-\\s]+award)\\M",title.match."\\mSABER\\M"))) order by notice_id limit 4

NON_FAR/structured_notice_type: select notice_id, solicitation_number, title, notice_type, active where active and (notice_type.imatch."(broad agency|\\mbaa\\M|commercial solutions|\\mcso\\M|other transaction|\\mota\\M)") order by notice_id limit 4

NON_FAR/title_keyword: select notice_id, solicitation_number, title, notice_type, active where active and (and(notice_type.imatch."(sources sought|\\mrfi\\M|request for information|special notice|presol|pre-sol|solicitation|combined|consolidat|bundle)",or(title.imatch."\\m(commercial solutions? openings?|other transactions?|broad agency announcements?)\\M",title.match."\\m(CSO|OTA|BAA)s?\\M"))) order by notice_id limit 4

negative award_notice_titled_vehicle: select notice_id, solicitation_number, title, notice_type, active where active and notice_type ~* 'Award Notice' and title ~* '\m(idiq|matoc|macc|bpa)\M' order by notice_id limit 3

negative solicitation_titled_rfi: select notice_id, solicitation_number, title, notice_type, active where active and notice_type ~* '(solicitation|combined)' and title ~* '\m(rfi|request for information)\M' order by notice_id limit 3

negative justification_naming_non_far: select notice_id, solicitation_number, title, notice_type, active where active and notice_type ~* 'justification' and title ~* '\m(ota|other transaction|baa|cso)\M' order by notice_id limit 3

negative special_notice_plain: select notice_id, solicitation_number, title, notice_type, active where active and notice_type ~* 'special notice' and title ~* '\m(industry day|notice of intent)\M' order by notice_id limit 3
_provenance.note: Each row carries _sampled_for (the rule or negative control it was drawn for). The test re-derives every classification from the frozen notice_type + title.
